notes: Judg.6.12: The construct expression mighty man of strength is rendered vaillant héros; match the head to héros and the qualifier to vaillant.
Judg.6.25: The relative clause was displaced in the first-pass map; the relative pronoun and supplied copula are distinguished.
Judg.6.27: The fear of doing the action by day is expressed in the French contrast night, not day; the repeated action is contextual.
Judg.6.29: Gideon's name belongs to the explicit subject, not the French indirect object leur.
Judg.6.33: The Jordan is supplied by the LSG's interpretation of the crossing; contextual only.
Judg.6.38: The second occurrence of the fleece is represented by en, rather than a second link to the first occurrence of toison.
